manualReview.type: possible non-obvious owner footgun (Law 3) - for severity-classifier
manualReview.title: No pre-session ETH balance check: OWNER's 0.01303 ETH can run out mid-session and halt the 24-tx broadcast inside the OnlyDispatcher window (C1)
manualReview.detail: unipooler-cutover:broadcast (package.json:76) runs --legacy --with-gas-price $CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 --skip-simulation --slow, and nothing checks OWNER's balance against the session's cost before tx 1. Each legacy tx is admitted only if remaining balance >= gasLimit x gasPrice, with gasLimit = 2x the estimate.

thresholdEstimate.inputs: side-effects.json transactions.gas: simulatedTotal 9,358,525 (gasleft delta, excludes ~21k intrinsic per tx: +~0.5M for 24 txs => ~9.86M real); createPair ~2.54M, UniPoolerV2 deploy ~2.90M, escrow deploy ~1.77M, exitAndSeed ~0.55M; the other 20 txs ~0.05-0.1M each; ownerEthBalance 0.013034998749 ETH; recorded maxAffordableUniformGasPriceGwei ~1.39 (excludes intrinsic).
thresholdEstimate.perTxAdmission: With the 2x limit, the tightest pre-window admission is tx 3 (escrow deploy): (0.01303 - (2.54M+2.90M)p) >= 2x1.77M p => p <= ~1.45 gwei. For the small window txs (8-19) the 2x headroom adds only ~0.1M, so the per-tx check barely moves the threshold. The binding constraint is cumulative spend.
thresholdEstimate.haltBands: Rough, from cumulative gas incl. intrinsic: <= ~1.30 gwei the session completes; ~1.30-1.45 gwei the halt lands in the tail (tx 19-24) or at the end of the window; ~1.45-1.6 gwei it lands inside the OnlyDispatcher window (tx 8-19, e.g. ~tx 14 at 1.5 gwei); >~1.6 gwei it halts at tx 3-6, after withdrawBPT (tx 4) and possibly before exitAndSeed, which is fail-safe custody (BPT in escrow, abort()).
thresholdEstimate.correctionToDedupPremise: The multiplier does NOT push the threshold 'well below' 1.4 gwei. From the recorded numbers, the window-halt band is about 1.45-1.6 gwei, just above the 1.39 headline, and completion needs <= ~1.3 gwei once intrinsic gas is counted. These are estimates, not fork-measured: forge's per-tx eth_estimateGas values were not captured.

manualReview.whyFootgun: The default is 0.3 gwei (cost ~0.0028 ETH) and recent basefee is 0.06-0.16 gwei, so the default is safe. Reaching the band takes an owner override of CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI to ~5x the default, e.g. after a gas spike stalls the 0.3 gwei session, which is C1's own halt cause. That override is a knowing input. Its consequence is not obvious: an override that fits the headline arithmetic (cost < balance) can still halt in the window, because of intrinsic gas and per-tx 2x admission, and leave index-4 mints DoS'd until a manual receipts-driven resume. A competent owner would plausibly be surprised. No funds at risk.
manualReview.suggestedDisposition: Severity-classifier to decide: either fold it into C1/DEDUP-001 as an additional halt cause with the safe-config line 'fund OWNER >= 2x (sum of 2x-estimate gas) x CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI before :broadcast, or add a preflight require(OWNER.balance >= ...)', or file a separate QA footgun. Not filed as a finding by the sanitizer.

findings.title: Index-4 mints revert OnlyDispatcher for 12 broadcast txs (tx 8..19) between hook.setDispatcher and replaceDispatcher, and the cutover has no resume gates, so a halt or gas stall inside the window leaves index 4 unmintable until a manual resume
findings.description: _runCutover orders step 8 (hook.setDispatcher(UniPoolerV2) = tx 7, then UniPoolerV2.setHook = tx 8), step 9 (setMinter, setPSM, setMaxTout, setBatchMinter, setBatchDonationSize, 4x setAuthorizedPooler, setNudgeStreamer = txs 9..18) and step 10 (replaceDispatcher = tx 19). BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.onDispatch reverts OnlyDispatcher unless msg.sender == dispatcher (BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol:109-110). Once tx 7 lands, the old pooler, which is still configs(4).dispatcher, can no longer dispatch, so every index-4 mint reverts until tx 19 lands. Step 9 depends on neither the hook nor the index, so its 11 txs sit inside the window for no reason. With --slow, a Ledger confirmation per tx and the 0.3 gwei legacy default, the window lasts minutes. If the session halts inside it (Ledger disconnect, gas spike above 0.3 gwei, forge receipt timeout), run() offers no resume: re-running reverts POISONED, or reverts at step 0 'index not on old pooler'/'hook not on old pooler'.
findings.impact: Availability only: index-4 NFT mints (the USDS mint) are DoS'd for the session window, and indefinitely after a mid-window halt until the operator hand-sends the remaining txs. No funds at risk.
findings.evidence: Fork: test_r41_window_mintsRevertOnlyDispatcher (logs/run41-forktests.log): a mint after step 7 succeeds, after steps 8 and 9 it reverts OnlyDispatcher(). Tx order from the broadcast-mode state diff: side-effects.json transactions.list (logs/fullrun-statediff.log). Same root cause as run-40 pps40 L-03, unchanged by story 103.
findings.recommendation: Run step 9 (configure UniPoolerV2) before step 8 in _runCutover. The window then shrinks to setHook + replaceDispatcher (2 txs). Optionally move replaceDispatcher immediately after hook.setDispatcher/setHook. In the runbook, document a receipts-driven manual resume for txs 8..19 (exact cast commands).
findings.dedupReason: Distinct root cause (step ordering widens the OnlyDispatcher window). Related to C5 (both touch 'no resume') but C1's fix is reordering steps 8/9/10 while C5's is the completion predicate and header text. Separate mitigations, so not merged.

findings.title: Script does not mitigate ycn L-28: with the default 10 bps floors and a public-mempool --slow broadcast, a ~30 sUSDS Balancer swap (fee ~$0.10) between tx 4 (withdrawBPT) and tx 5 (exitAndSeed) reverts the exit; 50 bps raises it only to ~160 sUSDS (~$0.53)
findings.reconcilesWithProject: yield-claim-nft (L-28, fix-pending, closeCondition: successful mainnet cutover)
findings.description: The owner triaged L-28 fix-pending on 2026-10-10 ('will handle it for the cutover'). Story 103's tooling does not handle it. The floors come from quote-balancer-exit-min-amounts.js (default 10 bps, max 50), and the npm :broadcast key sends every tx, including escrow.exitAndSeed, through the public mempool via $RPC_MAINNET. Nothing selects a private relay, and the runbook never mentions one. Anyone watching OWNER's tx 4 can swap on the Balancer phUSD/sUSDS pool so the proportional phUSD out falls below its floor, and tx 5 then reverts in the Vault.
findings.impact: DoS of the cutover, repeatable on every retry at about $0.10–$0.53 per attempt. Custody is fail-safe: the BPT stays in the escrow, OWNER is never credited, and abort() or a re-quoted exitAndSeed recover it. Not a loss, but after 30 Oct the pool is paused, which removes the swap vector and forces RECOVERY mode.
findings.evidence: Fork: test_r41_L28_griefCost_10bps (20 sUSDS no revert; 30/40/60 sUSDS revert AmountOutBelowMin(phUSD) 0x2f785e46) and test_r41_L28_griefCost_50bps (120 no revert; 160/220 revert). Both also assert that after the grief the escrow still holds 20401.809 BPT, OWNER holds 0, and a re-quoted exitAndSeed succeeds. Pool fee 0.30% (Vault getStaticSwapFeePercentage = 3e15). logs/run41-forktests.log.
findings.recommendation: Send the broadcast session (at minimum tx 5) through a private relay (e.g. Flashbots Protect as --rpc-url for :broadcast) and quote at 40–50 bps. Document in //UniPoolerCutover the resume after a griefed tx 5: re-quote on the escrow's BPT and call exitAndSeed privately. Leave L-28 fix-pending until the cutover lands, then apply its closeCondition.
findings.dedupReason: Unique. Cross-project reconcile to yield-claim-nft L-28 d77a482de757 (fix-pending, closeCondition: successful mainnet cutover). Not an incomplete fix of a phStaging entry: the fix was routed to phStaging story-103 and story-103 does not deliver it. Severity-classifier should weigh it against the owner's 'will handle it for the cutover' commitment.

findings.title: Canonical sUSDS/phUSD pair does not exist on mainnet yet: anyone can createPair and sync 1+1 wei for ~$1-2 of gas, after which the cutover fails step 2 permanently and the script has no recovery branch
findings.description: Step 2 requires pair reserves (0,0). A synced donation therefore reverts, as designed (story Decision 5), and the escrow's _requireEmptyPair reverts PairNotEmpty for the same state. getPair(sUSDS, phUSD) = 0x0 at ~26,221,761, so the attack is open to anyone today and stays open until the session's tx 1 lands. Disclosure: this is the same root cause as yield-claim-nft L-26 b2a29359fde5, which the owner set wont-fix on 2026-10-07: 'I guess, it should just panic and then I'll have to figure out what to do if there is a pair.' It is not re-raised. It is reconciled to the open phStaging pps39 L-01 for this entry point, whose run-39 note requires any recovery to be atomic (one tx doing transfer + pair.mint(newPooler), never Router02).
findings.impact: DoS only: the cutover tooling cannot run. BalancerPoolerV2 keeps serving index 4 and the BPT stays recoverable, but recovery needs new tooling, and the 30 Oct pause forces it into RECOVERY mode.
findings.evidence: Fork: test_r41_pairSyncedDonation_bricksPreview (third-party createPair + 1 wei each + sync makes preview revert 'UniPoolerCutoverCore: pair reserves not empty'); test_r41_pairUnsyncedDonation_doesNotBlock (the unsynced variant is now tolerated). cast call getPair = 0x0.
findings.recommendation: Owner decision (L-26 wont-fix stands). Cheapest pre-emption: create the pair in its own owner tx well before the session; the core reuses an existing pair at step 1. That alone does not stop a sync-poison, so also prepare, but do not run, an atomic recovery helper (transfer exit proceeds + pair.mint(UniPoolerV2) in one tx) per run-39's guidance.
findings.dedupReason: Unique. Reconciles to pps39 L-01 9a694ae01fe1. DISCLOSURE (must travel into the submission/QA text): same root cause as yield-claim-nft L-26 b2a29359fde5, owner-set wont-fix 2026-10-07 with triageReason 'I guess, it should just panic and then I'll have to figure out what to do if there is a pair.' findings.title: Rescue amounts (txs 20/21) and the withdrawBPT amount are baked in forge's local pass; interim index-4 mints before tx 7 or any third-party dust on the old pooler leave a residue on the paused old pooler that makes the mandatory :verify tail hard-fail
findings.description: With --skip-simulation, every 'read live' amount in step 11 (sUSDSRescued = balanceOf(oldPooler)) and the 'old pooler not drained' require are evaluated only in forge's local pass, and the amount is fixed in tx 20's calldata. Any public index-4 mint landing between the local pass and tx 7 wraps USDS into sUSDS on the old pooler (16.3 sUSDS per mint at the current price). So can any 1-wei donation of sUSDS/USDS/BPT to the old pooler. That residue survives tx 20, tx 24 pauses the pool, and _checkDrained keeps 'old pooler empty' a HARD require (revision 2 kept it hard on purpose). The :broadcast tail '&& npm run unipooler-cutover:verify' then exits non-zero right after a successful cutover.
findings.impact: Operational only. The verify chain breaks and needs one OWNER rescueERC20(token, UniPoolerV2, residue) tx, which is not pause-gated and is contract-to-contract. A stranger can re-grief :verify at any time after the cutover with 1 wei, the same donation class that revision 2 downgraded to a warning for the escrow.
findings.evidence: Fork: test_r41_bakedRescue_interimDust_failsVerify_ownerCanSweep: full cutover, +16 sUSDS on the old pooler, verify reverts 'verify: old pooler holds sUSDS'; OWNER rescueERC20 then verify passes. BalancerPoolerV2.sol:437-440 (rescueERC20 not pause-gated).
findings.recommendation: In _checkDrained, keep 'old pooler holds 0 BPT' hard but report sUSDS/USDS residue as a WARNING with the exact rescueERC20 command, or compare against a small dust threshold. In the runbook, note that interim mints during txs 1..7 leave sUSDS to sweep.
findings.verified: verified (modelled: residue injected after the run, since a single-pass harness re-reads live)
findings.dedupReason: Unique. Reconciles to pps40 Q-01 c8fb41a168e1 (ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast family).

findings.title: No resume tooling: story-specified step gating was replaced by all-or-nothing refusal, _alreadyCompleted treats configs(4)==UniPooler as 'completed' so a crash after tx 19 re-runs as 'Nothing to do', and the header's claim that any re-funding of an existing escrow goes through _fundEscrow is true of no reachable path
relatedLedger: story-103 review carry-forward [low] 'no guarded script entry point for resuming into an existing escrow'
findings.description: Story 103 Technical Details require 'step gating via _isConfigured/_trackConfig'. The implementation (story Decision 7, disclosed) writes the progress file once, at the end of forge's local pass, as 'completed', and has no step gating. _alreadyCompleted returns 'Nothing to do - no transaction sent' when the file is completed, the UniPooler has code and configs(4)==UniPooler. That is tx 19's effect alone, and txs 20-24 (sUSDS rescue, USDS rescue, wrapUsds, old.setMinter(OWNER), old.pause()) may not have landed. Separately, the header states 'Any re-funding of an existing escrow goes through the core's guarded _fundEscrow' (:53-54), but no entry point ever calls _fundEscrow on an existing escrow: run() always deploys a fresh pooler and escrow. A resume into an existing escrow is a hand-typed cast withdrawBPT with no L-27 guard.
findings.impact: Misleading operator output on the most likely partial-failure path; :verify, next in the && chain, does catch it ('verify: old pooler not paused'). The L-27 protection on the manual-resume path rests only on the header rule, which the owner is trusted to follow. Live state also lowers the L-27 stakes: the old pooler holds only escrow snapshot tokens.
findings.evidence: Fork: test_r41_crashAfterReplaceDispatcher_rerunIsNoOp_verifyCatches (re-run no-op, verify reverts 'verify: old pooler not paused'); test_r41_L27_withoutGuard_manualResumeStrandsX (the unguarded manual path strands a non-snapshot token). Story file 'Technical Details / Progress' bullet; Decision 7.
findings.recommendation: Make _alreadyCompleted require the full end state (old pooler paused, minter OWNER, drained) and otherwise print a precise list of which of txs 20..24 are missing. Correct the header sentence, or add a small RESUME_ESCROW=<addr> entry point that calls _fundEscrow / exitAndSeed / step 11-12 against an existing escrow behind the same guards.
findings.dedupReason: Unique root cause (completion predicate checks a single effect; story-specified step gating absent; inaccurate header claim). Shares the ForgeLocalPassPrecedesBroadcast backdrop with C4 and C6 and the 'no resume' theme with C1 but needs its own fix. reconcilesWith null: new entry. Also carries a Law-2 faithfulness element (story Technical Details require _isConfigured/_trackConfig step gating; deviation disclosed as story Decision 7).

findings.title: Plan §4 step 11's post-broadcast 'forked test mint dispatches, wraps and accrues debt' never runs against landed state: :verify has no simulated mint and the :broadcast tail's trailing :preview is a guaranteed no-op
findings.description: Story 103 Background quotes Plan §4 step 11 'Verify: … A forked test mint dispatches, wraps and accrues debt.' The implementation performs the mint only in _previewEndToEnd, pre-broadcast, on simulated state. VerifyUniPoolerCutover checks wiring and simulates pool() but not a mint. The :broadcast tail '… && npm run unipooler-cutover:verify && npm run unipooler-cutover:preview' re-runs preview, which returns at _alreadyCompleted() before any E2E code once the progress file is completed and live. The trailing step therefore cannot exercise the landed contracts.
findings.impact: Verification gap only. The wiring checks in _checkWiring cover most mint-path dependencies (minter slot, hook both ways, configs(4), paused flags), so this is low value.
findings.evidence: Fork: test_r41_fullRun_stateDiff_verify shows the ':preview tail is a no-op' assertion and the log line 'Nothing to do - no transaction sent'. VerifyUniPoolerCutover.s.sol:35-85 has no mint.
findings.recommendation: Move the dealt-user test mint (in a reverted snapshot) into VerifyUniPoolerCutover.run, next to _simulateQuotedPool, and drop or relabel the trailing :preview in :broadcast.
findings.dedupReason: Unique (Plan §4 step 11 post-broadcast E2E mint never runs on landed state). It cites the same _alreadyCompleted no-op as C5, but as the reason the trailing :preview is vacuous, not as the defect. Different fix (add mint to :verify). New entry.

findings.title: UniswapHelper is still existence-only (_requirePair) at e75ee07; if story 111's helper is deployed and UI-exposed before this cutover, an honest add-liquidity in the tx 1->tx 5 window makes exitAndSeed revert PairNotEmpty
findings.description: Story 111 calls the helper deploy independent of the cutover ('may go before or after'). The helper is not on mainnet (book UniswapHelper = 0x0). The cutover creates the pair at tx 1 and seeds it at tx 5. If the helper is live first, PairNotFound stops reverting after tx 1, and a user's add-liquidity lands a first-LP mint on the empty pair before tx 5. exitAndSeed then reverts UniPoolerCutoverEscrow__PairNotEmpty (synced reserves).
findings.impact: DoS of the cutover; the BPT stays safe in the escrow and abort() restores it. The ordering hazard disappears if the helper is deployed after the cutover.
findings.evidence: Static for this run: UniswapHelper.sol:428-431 unchanged; escrow _requireEmptyPair UniPoolerCutoverEscrow.sol:359-375. Run-40 fork-proved the helper path (pps40 L-02). The synced-reserves revert is re-proved here by test_r41_pairSyncedDonation_bricksPreview.
findings.recommendation: Sequence uniswap-helper:broadcast strictly after unipooler-cutover:verify passes, and state this in story 111 and the runbook. Alternatively, land the one-line 'reserves != 0' check in _requirePair first.
